liveOperations.shortcut: Monitor live data and immediately stop a source, park or attraction.
liveOperations.title: Live operations
liveOperations.subtitle: Monitor collection and precisely stop what must no longer be collected or shown, without redeploying.

configuration.title: Server configuration enforces a stop
configuration.description: The controls below can never reactivate something disabled by production configuration.

controls.title: Controlled scopes
controls.description: The source applies to all live data. A park or attraction can then be stopped separately.

backtest.error: Unable to calculate the reliability study.
backtest.notPublic: This internal study publishes no forecast. It only decides whether the method deserves a pilot.
backtest.methodDescription: Each hourly point is predicted using only the previous {{days}} days. No future value enters training.

reason.InsufficientEvaluationPoints: There are not enough independent points to evaluate yet.
reason.InsufficientEvaluationDays: The period does not cover enough days yet.
reason.BaselineNotBeaten: The method does not reduce error enough compared with the simple baseline.
reason.IntervalMiscalibrated: The interval is too unreliable or too wide to be useful.
reason.DriftDetected: Recent error is degrading beyond the accepted threshold.
reason.CandidatePassed: The method beats the baseline, its interval remains useful and no blocking drift is detected.

messages.updated: The control is applied and retained in history.
messages.replayed: The quarantine batch was replayed with a bounded size.
messages.replayPartial: Part of the batch was replayed; some incidents remain blocked.
messages.replayBlocked: No incident could be replayed because current controls still block them.

errors.load: Unable to load live data operations.
errors.mutation: The control was not saved. Reload the page and try again.
errors.replay: The quarantine batch could not be replayed.
